next.reason: 1985 GR1 holds literal-1/identifier-1 in a temporary, multiplies each identifier-2 by it left to right and stores the product in that identifier-2. §2023:14.9.26.4 GR1: 'The product of the multiplier and the multiplicand is stored as the new value of the data item referenced by identifier-2', the multiplier determined once in the initial evaluation; §2023:14.7.7 GR4 stores 'in the left-to-right order in which the receiving data items are specified in the statement'. The multiplier/multiplicand naming swap is terminology. 2023 GR3 is the standard-arithmetic variant, which no 1985 program selects; it states no part of this rule.
